_note: Synthetic samples shaped like real Wikipedia REST summary + categories responses (see https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/ and the action API's prop=categories), not a live capture. This environment has no outbound network access to Wikipedia, so — unlike the cycling desk plugin's feed-items.json, which is a real capture — these model the documented response conventions by hand rather than replaying real data. What is being tested is Bio_Mapper's parsing logic against that shape, not any particular rider's actual record.
